Software Development: Ukraine Edition

Business owners, who often have to deal with software development issues, know that Ukraine is one of the best places to hire or outsource specialists like that from. Why is that, you might ask? Well, over the last decade, the growth of Ukraine technology field has been massive and that is just the beginning. Ukrainian IT market is growing with an enormous speed as well as Ukraine development status. As for now, there are more than 1,000 software development companies in Ukraine and 90,000 employees that are working in the IT field. These numbers are expected to be doubled by the year 2020. This makes software companies in Ukraine one of the biggest sources of the workforce within the IT field in Europe.

It is also an impressive fact to know, that Ukraine is officially one of those countries that provide the biggest amount of outsourcing services in Europe. In case you have not heard of this term before, outsourcing is a process of delegating some part of your company’s tasks to a specialist, who does not work there. With the growth of globalization, outsourcing became a big hit in the business world, as it has lots of benefits that can help companies scale up a business:

  • Cost reduction. While you are outsourcing workforce you actually are saving lots of money for your business. This is the difference in wages between Ukraine and other countries that makes it so profitable for IT companies.
  • Increased efficiency. While you are outsourcing some part of your tasks, you are actually able to focus on more primary problems that need your personal attention and cannot be delegated to anybody else. Thus, your business will only thrive this way.
  • Find talents. Outsourcing brings you to the big world of amazing business opportunities. Now you can hire anyone from anywhere, therefore you can find someone who is a perfect match for your needs and project.
  • Round-the-clock operations. Due to time zone differences, you now have the opportunity to run your business 24/7 with the help of your outsourced team.

All in all, such massive popularity of IT field in Ukraine could be explained, first of all, by its great profitability – due to currency exchange rate dollar salaries turn out to be pretty big when converted into Ukrainian money. Another thing that influences this increase of interest towards software development and IT field in general is the fact, that for most Ukrainian specialists IT is something, that can lead them towards a better future in a professional sphere.

How to Hire Ukrainian Development Company

If you finally have decided to hire Ukrainian software development company for your project, there are some things that you should know about the hiring process. There are usually three ways that you can hire someone from the software development Ukraine field – freelance, remote or in-house. Let’s now quickly get through each of those so that you get a better understanding.

  • Local

In this case, we are talking about a good old office job. In the case of software development, this might be the best option for you as you can have easy access to your employees whenever you need to. Trust us, this is worth paying for the rent a little bit more, as software development is a field that often requires a lot of teamwork.

  • Freelance

Hiring a Ukrainian freelance developer might let you significantly reduce your costs due to overall low prices in this country and the high professionalism of developers. However, you have to pay extra attention to your candidate’s resume and portfolio, as in this case you most likely will not be able to hold a personal interview with him. Another thing for you to consider is the place that you hire your freelance developer from – we recommend you using professional websites, like Upwork, that give you at least some sort of a guarantee that the job will be done.

  • Remote

This is something that could be considered as a ‘golden middle’ between your and your employee’s interests. In this case, you hire a developer that works for you officially, but you do not have to pay the rent for the office, as he can choose the place to work from himself. In addition, you can reach your employees whenever any questions occur.
